    Profile

    Emma is Noah's classmate at the School of Magic in Lustburg. In order to escape from a life of poverty and hardship she studied and studied and received a scholarship for the academy. She acts like she's lazy and doesn't like putting in effort so as to keep her dark past a secret.

    Origin: Lustburg
    Gender: Female
    Height: 159cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Oct 5
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Fiery Imperial Skies
    Likes: Money
    Hobbies: Saving money, taking walks
    Illust: yuui
    CV: 金村明日香
